name: repertoire
description: Skills for coding agents: worktrees beside the checkout, reviewer lenses mined from a repo's own review history, and numbers presented so a reader can trust them.

plugins.name: sidework
plugins.description: Run Claude Code tasks in git worktrees beside the main checkout (../<repo>-sidework-<session>) instead of nested inside it.

plugins.name: build-review-lens
plugins.description: Mine a repository's review history into a reviewer lens skill that reviews your branch the way its maintainer will, before the PR opens.

plugins.name: data-story
plugins.description: Put measured numbers in front of a reader: the takeaway first, then a sentence, a table or a chart, and a line on how it was measured.
